content.title: Devner Nuggets vs San Antonio Spurs injury report: Who's playing, injured and questionable players, head-to-head records, team stats, and more (March 12, 2026)
content.text: Denver Nuggets vs San Antonio Spurs (Image via GettyThe Denver Nuggets play the San Antonio Spurs on March 12, 2026, at Frost Bank Center. Denver enters the game with a 40-26 record. San Antonio is 48-17 and currently sits near the top of the Western Conference standings.The Spurs are favored by 4.5 points, and the projected total for the game is 239.5. Several players on both teams are dealing with injuries, which could affect rotations and availability before tip-off.Denver Nuggets vs San Antonio Spurs Injury Report (March 12, 2026)Both teams have players listed on the injury report.For Denver, Jamal Murray is listed as probable because of an ankle issue and is expected to play. Aaron Gordon is questionable with a hamstring injury, which could affect Denver’s frontcourt if he cannot go. David Jones Garcia is out for the season after ankle surgery.Denver’s current rotation includes Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Aaron Gordon, Christian Braun, Johnson, and Jonas Valanciunas. San Antonio’s group includes Victor Wembanyama, De’Aaron Fox, Stephon Castle, Devin Vassell, and Julian Champagnie.Western Conference StandingsSan Antonio enters the game with a 48-17 record, which places the team second in the Western Conference. The Spurs have also been strong at home, holding a 25-6 record at Frost Bank Center.Denver is 40-26 and sits between fifth and sixth place in the conference standings. The Nuggets have been solid on the road with a 22-13 record but have had some inconsistent stretches recently.Denver Nuggets vs San Antonio Spurs Head-to-Head RecordSan Antonio Spurs lead the all-time regular season series against Denver with a 126-81 record.The teams have split their meetings during the 2025-26 season. The Spurs won the previous matchup 139-136 on November 28.
